title: Scaling the supremum norm
statement: For a finite nonempty set $\Omega$, a real number $c$, and a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, the supremum norm of $x\mapsto c f(x)$ equals $|c|$ times the supremum norm of $f$.
